title: In-chat search still matches pages by a generation counter (begin_query/ request_chat_search(search_gen))
trigger: type a query, change query while page in flight
effect: late page of old query matched by counter not RequestId

title: History calendar pages matched by SearchPurpose::GetChatMessageCalendar{generation} counter
trigger: open calendar, switch media tab while page in flight

title: Bot create/check username answers matched by generation counters (CheckBotUsername/CreateBot purposes)
trigger: type username, retype while check out

title: PasskeyAdd::FetchingOptions(request) and Create Passkey never checks the request still exists in session.requests (the list stage does); a lost request leaves begin_register returning Ok(None) forever
trigger: click Create Passkey, connection drops so request is lost without answer
effect: Create Passkey spins until app restart

title: fetch_blocked_senders asks from offset = loaded length, so the "always fresh" fetch on every Privacy open never refetches page 0 once the list is loaded (and after a chat-bar Block on an unloaded list it starts at offset 1, skipping the server's first entry)
trigger: load Settings > Privacy > Blocked, block a user from another device (or block from a chat while the list is unloaded), reopen Privacy
effect: blocked list stays stale until restart; the newest server entry is never shown; has_more can stay true with a duplicate-only page
fix: offset 0 refetch on open (Fetch::Outdated) with page request tied to RequestId

title: A refused send of getStickerCategories leaves sticker_categories Idle (GetStickerCategories is not in StickerLists::for_purpose, so sticker_request cannot fail it) although the doc says a failed ask stays Failed so a render never re-asks; the panel's render-deferred fetch re-sends on every render
trigger: open sticker panel while the client refuses sends (closing client)
effect: a new getStickerCategories attempt on each render of the panel and no Failed/Retry state
fix: fail the Fetch in fetch_sticker_categories on Err

title: StickerManager::open is a session bool mirroring whether the manager box is on screen, set and cleared by hand from the UI (stickers_manager/mod.rs, masks_ui.rs) beside the box's own state; covers_requested is cleared only with it
trigger: open stickers manager, switch account or close the window without the box's close path
effect: manager.open stays true so pump_sticker_manager keeps downloading covers
fix: derive from the box (OnScreen) instead of a session flag
